_comment: Layer registry. The five SPINES ship populated - they are the system's own anatomy and
we know them exactly. FLOW layers are the project's pipeline stages and start empty:
they are defined through the project via the evolution protocol, never guessed from
folder names at adoption. Components with no flow layer sit in the 'unplaced' band,
which is visible on purpose - honest unplacement beats confident wrong placement.

spines.title: MEMORY
spines.blurb: Durable project memory: status, decision log, lessons, tasks, research, reference.

spines.title: GOVERN
spines.blurb: Gates and contracts: policy enforcement, write validation, handshake envelopes, human gates.

spines.title: OBSERVE
spines.blurb: The always-on record: capture, heartbeat, seal, rollup, anchor, token ledger, retrospective analysis.

spines.title: CONSOLE
spines.blurb: One page of command and control: NOW, MAP, STORY, WORK.

spines.title: EVOLVE
spines.blurb: The system changing itself on evidence: the ritual, retro proposals, the anatomist, pruning.

unplaced.title: unplaced
unplaced.blurb: Components the anatomist has not yet placed into a flow layer. Visible by design.
